extracted.stage: Pre-grant; inheritance tax due before grant of probate
extracted.summary: An executor of his late father's estate, mostly a Guildford property worth about £446,500, asks to borrow around £27,500 to pay inheritance tax before the grant of probate is issued.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry and for the detail about your late father's estate. To take this further we would need a copy of the will and confirmation of your appointment as executor, the IHT400 or calculation showing the tax due, and evidence of the property valuation and title, together with a schedule of the estate's other assets and liabilities. It would also help to have written confirmation from Ashcroft Legal LLP that they are instructed, along with proof of your identity and address. Once we have these we can review the matter properly; I am not able to comment at this stage on whether funding is available or on terms. Please let me know if you would like a list of the documents in a format you can pass to your solicitors.
